Q5543.reason: ADP degradation via AMP deaminase produces ammonia, then IMP to hypoxanthine and uric acid; urea and creatinine are not direct products.

Q5544.reason: Effluent leakage onto peristomal skin is the typical cause of excoriation.

Q5546.reason: Smoke particles physically depositing on neighbor's property is treated as trespass (intrusion by tangible matter), though nuisance and negligence are plausible.
